# `array_insert`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Places val into index pos of array x.
Array indices start at 1. The maximum negative index is -1 for which the function inserts
new element after the current last element.
Index above array size appends the array, or prepends the array if index is negative,
with 'null' elements.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_insert(x, pos, val)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 3 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_insert, example 1
> SELECT array_insert(array(1, 2, 3, 4), 5, 5);
[1,2,3,4,5]
```

```sql
-- array_insert, example 2
> SELECT array_insert(array(5, 4, 3, 2), -1, 1);
[5,4,3,2,1]
```

```sql
-- array_insert, example 3
> SELECT array_insert(array(5, 3, 2, 1), -4, 4);
[5,4,3,2,1]
```
